eli5.text: The terminal app now asks the AI service to create a short, descriptive name for your conversation when you send the very first message. Chats where you supply your own AI connection are skipped, as the service only names conversations it is directly processing. When you open the chat history or look at the bottom of the screen, you will see this new name instead of a long snippet of your first question, which makes it easier to identify specific sessions at a glance.

facts: The model's data-use line (as on web's picker): quiet, after the status lines and before the referral pitch.
The server's reason the pool is smaller than the account's own (a device's shared allowance, the VPN pool). Without it a shared pool reads "0/0 hours remaining" and looks like a broken account.
First line of its panel: no gap above.
The account is on the Freebucks meter: referrals pay hours, and nothing here may count sessions.
Never let a height-starved landing column squash the banner — that would draw the copy control on top of the pitch line above it.
entries.title: CLI update: freebuff-chat-header

ai.title: CLI chat header omits empty panel and adds data-use line
ai.summary: The CLI chat header now suppresses the bordered status panel when no session, meter, plan, or referral data is available, preventing an empty frame from rendering on launch. The model's data-use disclosure, derived from `model.warning` or `FREEBUFF_AI_TRAINING_NOTICE`, is moved to the bottom of the status lines, appearing after the streak bonus and before the referral pitch. The `FreebuffReferralBanner` component accepts a new `flush` prop that removes the top margin when the banner is the first line of the panel, ensuring the copy control does not overlap the pitch text in height-constrained terminals.
ai.evidence: In `cli/src/components/freebuff-chat-header.tsx`, the diff moves the `model.warning` and `FREEBUFF_AI_TRAINING_NOTICE` logic into a computed `dataUse` variable appended to the `lines` array, and conditionally renders the bordered `<box>` only when `lines.length > 0` to prevent an empty frame. In `cli/src/components/freebuff-referral-banner.tsx`, a new `flush` prop is added to set `marginTop` to 0 when the banner is the first item in the panel.

eli5.text: The information panel at the top of the terminal assistant now hides itself when there is no account status or referral offer to display, so you no longer see an empty box on launch. A line explaining how your data is used now appears near the bottom of that panel, sitting below your usage stats and above the friend-referral pitch. The referral pitch itself now removes its top gap when it is the only thing in the box, keeping the text neatly spaced on screens with little room. If you see the panel, the only new line is the note about data use; if you do not see it, there was nothing to report to you.
